text: Continuous integration (CI) is a practice where developers regularly add their code to a shared project. Every time they do this, automated builds start immediately. The system compiles the code and runs tests without any manual work. This helps teams catch issues early, before they become serious problems. When a test fails, developers know quickly and can fix the mistake straight away. CI pipelines make this process smooth and reliable. They include steps like building, testing, and sometimes deploying the software. Thanks to CI, teams save time, reduce stress, and produce better quality software.
